experiment_data.hypothesis: OCC loss cutoff at step 35000: use OCC auxiliary supervision for first 35K steps (acquire spatial awareness) then disable OCC loss (let action loss dominate, recover TSR). OCC@50K shows 47500→50000 divergence suggesting late-stage OCC loss interferes with action policy. If cutoff avoids this interference, expect CAR≥0.80 (matching Random's regularization benefit) with TSR≥vanilla (no late-stage degradation).
